title: Typing Effect Configuration Guide
content:
This article explains how to configure and use the typing effect in Hugo Fluid theme.
What is the Typing Effect The typing effect is a dynamic text display effect where text appears character by character like a typewriter, with a blinking cursor, making the page more dynamic. In the Fluid theme, the typing effect is mainly used for the homepage subtitle (slogan) display.
Basic Configuration Configure the typing effect in config/_default/params.toml:
